editorProtocol.build: production real CodeMirror; Writer live preview ON
editorProtocol.device: S00 fixed test machine/viewport/zoom/fonts, no background load
editorProtocol.samples: 3 warmups + 7 valid samples per shell/action; interleaved
editorProtocol.receiptShape: samples[units][shell][action] = { warmupSamplesMs[3], rawSamplesMs[7], longTasksMs[] }; summary statistics are computed, not trusted
editorProtocol.ime: exact expected document/selection/cursor after composition and undo; zero loss, zero duplicates
editorProtocol.unstable: MAD/median > 10% permits one identical rerun only; still unstable=inconclusive

reject: required action not pass or evidence empty
editor absolute/relative/IME gates fail or Writer live preview disabled
negativeFixtures: only one action filled then feature PASS -> reject
U16 archive owner B02 instead of B01 -> reject
Classic evidence for Writer action -> reject
two shells both slow even equal -> reject
IME loses/repeats text despite fast samples -> reject
live preview disabled yields fast sample -> reject
